headline: Co-founder & CTO, Tvara | BE CSE, SVMIT (VTU) '26 | AI, C++, CUDA
about: Co-founder and CTO of Tvara, building agentic AI and RAG systems for enterprise workflows across 6 countries. Previously a contract Software Architect with the Department of EDCS, Government of Karnataka. Raised $75K pre-seed at a $1M valuation with Marwari Catalysts.

experience.description: Raised $75,000 in pre-seed funding at a $1M valuation, backed by Marwari Catalysts; scaled Tvara across 6 countries with 50+ global partners and technical ecosystem support from Google Cloud and AWS. Led architecture of production AI systems combining LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows and external APIs, including persona- and profile-aware retrieval for context-sensitive enterprise reasoning. Directed technical strategy across AI infrastructure, integrations and enterprise deployments with CXOs and engineering teams.

experience.organization: Dept. of EDCS, Government of Karnataka
experience.description: Led a 5-member engineering team to architect and deploy a statewide Social Economic Survey application with secure data capture, multilingual workflows and government database integration. Designed infrastructure and rollout for 150K field surveyors supporting large-scale concurrent data collection, architecting technology intended to cover 60M+ citizens across Karnataka.

experience.position: Lead Unreal Game Design Remote Intern
experience.description: Integrated real-world maps into an unannounced game via Cesium Maps for Unreal Engine. Implemented vehicle motion and physics for cars, trucks and helicopters with chase and timer mechanics. Worked across Unreal Engine Blueprints, C++, version control and Unreal Multi-user Editing (MUE).

Proposed and prototyped a feature for The Sims 4 allowing players to record real-life voice or music as in-game songs. Patched a bug fix and optimised the Sims 4 codebase by implementing improved C++ vectors instead of arrays.

Led a 50+ member technical club, growing membership from 30 to 50; organised the college's largest 24-hour national-level hackathon with 1,800+ applicants, and taught DSA to 50+ junior students over five weeks.

Taught DSA to 50+ junior-year students over five weeks, culminating in a hackathon. Organised TechVistara 4.0, TechVistara 3.0, MLOps Workshop, C4GT Workshop, Git Workshop and GameDev Workshop with 400+ attendees per event.
